Title: Task Tracking Feature V1 Implementation
Content: MemorySmith now has a file-backed task domain at Data/Tasks with a site-level /tasks workbench and api/tasks endpoints for CRUD, status updates, comments, links, attachments, history, and soft/hard delete. Assignee handling is dictionary-first with Directory mode and optional Custom text mode. Linked page checks are warning-only: missing pages do not block linking and produce page_link_warning activity entries. Finite state transition enforcement is intentionally deferred as an optional future feature. Open items from Data/Pages/workbench/tasks.md have been imported into backend task records with tracker-import metadata and durable activity events.
